answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 22890 Country: India Title: I had intercouse with my wife while she was in her periods. I had prayed salatu touba for this sin. kindly advise what I have to do to clear this sin? Question: I had intercouse with my wife while she was in her periods. I had prayed salatu touba for this sin. kindly advise what I have to do to clear this sin? Answer ID: 22890 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 918/918/M=1431) Give something in charity and keep on doing istighfar. In future avoid having intercourse in this state. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
